definition: that which is, one has, etc.; wealth; estate.
example_en: His wealth is the greatest in the village.

definition: an injunction of Koran, read out at the time of marriage.
example_en: The Maulvi read the Koranic injunction at the time of the marriage.

definition: a bulky piece of unshaped timber; a log.
example_en: They dragged the log in from the forest.

definition: assets, used in day-to-day business, that are readily convertible into cash, without loss in value; current assets or liquid assets.
example: ಆ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಚಾಲತಿಮಾಲು ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದೆ.
example_en: That company's current assets have increased compared to last year.

definition: allowing light rays to pass through so that objects on the other side may be distinctly seen; transparent.
example: ಈ ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಗಾಜಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಒಳಗಿನದೆಲ್ಲ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Everything inside can be seen through this transparent glass.

definition: that can be obtained; obtainable.
example_en: Heaven is not easily obtainable.

definition: a man who acts as, uses the office of a minister in his absence or assists him; a deputy minister.
example_en: In the minister's absence, the deputy minister conducted the meeting.

definition: sudden fear; alarm; fright.
example_en: He felt sudden fear and alarm from the abrupt noise.

definition: a lens that makes an object look much bigger than actual it is, when seen through it; a magnifying glass.
example: ಅವನು ಭೂತಗಾಜು ಬಳಸಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿದನು.
example_en: He read the small letters using a magnifying glass.

definition: much hotness; heat.
example_en: The afternoon heat in summer was unbearable.

definition: unduly exaggerated self-esteem; conceit; behaviour characterised by haughtiness.
example: ಅವನ ಸದಮದವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Seeing his conceit, no one spoke with him.

definition: the quality of being easy; easiness.
example_en: The students appreciated the easiness of this exam.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The gardener uprooted the bōgāra plant along with its roots.

definition: strength, courage of a loyal soldier.
example_en: The loyal soldier's courage was an example to all.

definition: that which is legal or lawful.
example: ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ನ್ಯಾಯಾನಪೇತ ಎಂದು ವಕೀಲರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The lawyer said that agreement is lawful.

definition: a woman (in gen.) 2) a woman, in relation to a man to whom she is married; a wife.
example: ಆ ಇಂತಿ ತನ್ನ ಗಂಡನ ಜೊತೆ ಸುಖವಾಗಿ ಬಾಳಿದಳು.
example_en: That wife lived happily with her husband.

definition: a thorough looking.
example_en: The doctor conducted a thorough looking over of the patient.

definition: a social convention carried on by tradition and enforced by social disapproval of any violation; a custom.
example: ಈ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳೆಯ ತಗಹು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಾಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In this village, an old custom is still observed.

definition: the condition of occupying the entire space or being spread throughout.
example_en: The whole room was filled with the spread of light.

definition: an object used to close a hole, gap, outlet, etc.; a plug; a wedge.
example_en: He pressed the plug tightly into the mouth of the bottle.

definition: something spoken in low voice to avoid being heard by others; a secret-talk.
example_en: They were speaking in secret whispers in the corner.

definition: an irresistable desire for sexual intercourse.
example_en: Overcome by irresistible sexual desire, he forgot even his lesson.

definition: the quality or fact of being extraordinarily valorous.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನ ಬಲುಗೈತನ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That soldier's extraordinary valor stood out in the battle.

definition: manner or mode of a) expression of one's feelings, opinion.
example_en: The manner of his speech drew everyone in.

definition: the occupation of tending and herding of cows.
example_en: His family makes a living by cow herding.

definition: one of the commonest minerals, silicon dioxide, SiO2 , having many varieties that differ in colour, lustre, etc., and occurring either in masses (as agate, bloodstone, chalcedony, jasper, etc.) or in crystals (as rock crystal, amethyst, citrine, etc.); quartz.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಳಿಯ ಬೆಣಚು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: White quartz is found in abundance on that hill.

definition: to mix a substance with a liquid (as in preparing a medicine).
example_en: They mixed the medicine with water and made him drink it.

definition: to treat with deliberate disregard; to slight; to disregard.
example_en: He disregarded his friend's advice.

definition: a servant appointed in a temple; a temple servant.
example_en: The temple servant used to perform worship every day.

definition: extraordinary beauty; matchless handsomeness.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಅನುಪಮರೂಪವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed seeing that girl's matchless beauty.

definition: the quality or fact of being thin or gaunt; thinness.
example_en: He became gaunt with thinness due to poverty.

definition: incidental - a) happening as a result of or in connection with something more important; b) likely to happen as a result or concomitant.
example_en: That incident happened incidentally.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear; to be distressed by the emotion of fear.
example_en: Hearing the sound from the forest, the children became afraid.

definition: a white powder, sodium bicarbonate, NaHCO3, used as a leavening agent; sodium bicarbonate.
example: ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಹಿಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಅಡಿಗೆಸೋಡ ಹಾಕಿ ಕಲಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She mixed a little baking soda into the idli batter.

definition: to rush against with rash determination.
example: ಎದುರಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಎತ್ತು ಕೊಬ್ಬರಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಉರುಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The ox that came in front rushed against him with rash determination and knocked him to the ground.

definition: that which is very tall; a skyscraper.
example: ಅವರು ಗಗನಚುಂಬಕ ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನೇ ಮಹಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They live on the twentieth floor of a skyscraper.

definition: a beautiful necklace or garland.
example_en: A beautiful necklace shone on the bride's neck.

definition: to expand, develop (oneself).
example_en: She wished to develop herself through her own effort.

definition: the place or region below.
example_en: The clothes are kept in the region below.

definition: broken pieces of something.
example_en: Broken pieces of glass lay on the floor.

definition: the cardinal number eighteen; 18.
example: ಆ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಷ್ಟಾದಶ ಪುರಾಣಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಣೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That book has a description of the eighteen Puranas.

definition: a greedy, stingy woman who hoards money for its own sake, even at the expense of personal comfort; a miser.
example: ಜಿಪುಣೆಯಾದ ಅವಳು ಒಂದು ಪೈಸೆಯನ್ನೂ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Being a miser, she does not spend even a single paisa.

definition: highly pleasing or soothing speech.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಅಮರ್ದುನುಡಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಜನರ ಮನಸ್ಸು ತಣಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's soothing speech, the people's minds were pacified.

definition: bad smell like that of stale fat, oil or completely putrefied vegetable.
example_en: A rancid smell was coming from the stale oil.

definition: the Supreme Being transcending all possible attributes; the Absolute.
example_en: The teacher gave a discourse about the Supreme Being.

definition: an organ of a fish for obtaining oxygen from water; the gill.
example: ಮೀನಿನ ಕಿವಿರುಗಳು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಸಿರಾಡಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The gills of a fish help it breathe in water.

definition: the inland region of an island.
example_en: The inland region of the island was covered with dense forest.

definition: to turn around, spin or rotate rapidly on one's axis.
example: ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಗು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಸುಳಿಸುತ್ತಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The child spun around rapidly in play and fell down.

definition: a ceiling of a house, made of wooden boards.
example_en: The wooden ceiling of the old house was decorated with carvings.

definition: to pull back and forth or up and down repeatedly.
example_en: The door was swinging back and forth in the wind.

definition: a line of connected railroad cars pulled by a locomotive.
example_en: The railroad train was passing over the bridge.

definition: something that is folded three times.
example_en: She folded the saree three times over.

definition: (in composition) totalling to three.
example_en: That building has three floors.

definition: the condition or fact of shattering or being shattered, broken into pieces.
example_en: The house was shattered to pieces by the storm.

definition: to uncover; to remove the cover or veil; to unveil.
example_en: She uncovered the veil from her face.

definition: to win; to get victory.
example_en: Our team got victory in the match.

definition: the military class, in gen.
example_en: He was born into the military class and learned the art of war.

definition: a falling down or an instance of a small body called meteor or meteoroid, that becomes visible as it passes through the atmosphere.
example_en: The falling meteor shone brightly in the night sky.

definition: an indeclinable used to express disgust, abhorrence, detestation, deep repugnance, etc.
example_en: Ugh, such a thing should never have been done!

definition: to reflect the sound waves; to echo.
example_en: When he shouted on the hill, the sound echoed back.

definition: a place where water is oozing out.
example_en: Frogs live in the place where water is oozing out.

definition: the Supreme Lord.
example_en: The devotees meditated on the Supreme Lord.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The dāre plant had spread along the bank of the pond.

definition: to cause (hair) to become disarranged and untidy; to leave hair uncombed and unbraided.
example_en: The wind caused her hair to become disarranged.

definition: the state or quality of being superior or higher, greater, better, etc.; superiority.
example_en: The superiority of his knowledge was greater than everyone's.

definition: a man having sanction of authority.
example_en: That man having sanction of authority issued the order.

definition: an officer who hears and settles legal cases.
example_en: The village's judicial officer settled the dispute.

definition: a stick used to beat.
example_en: The grandmother frightened the child with a beating stick.

definition: that which is born from the earth; a plant; a tree.
example_en: The peepal tree is a sacred plant born of the earth.

definition: to put forward an ostensible reason, excuse; to give a pretext.
example_en: She gave a pretext for not attending the meeting.

definition: the telling of a happening or connected series of happenings, whether true or fictitious; a narration; a story.
example_en: Everyone was astonished hearing his narration.

definition: a valorous soldier.
example: ರಾಜನ ಸೈನ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಟುಭಟ ಮುಂದೆ ನಿಂತು ಹೋರಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: In the king's army, the valorous soldier stood in front and fought.

definition: (in composition) at the rear or back; behind; back.
example_en: They placed the sack at the back part of the cart.

definition: a reproductiveof angiosperm plants having showy or colourful petals; a flower.
example_en: White flowers have bloomed on that tree.

definition: accepted, honoured or recognised by scholars.
example_en: That work is accepted and honoured by scholars.

definition: a property belonging to several persons (of a family); an undivided property.
example_en: That house was the undivided property of the brothers.

definition: to discover; to find out.
example_en: The police discovered the thief's trail.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A mada tree had grown by the side of the field.

definition: a kind of large, black bee that makes a buzzing sound.
example_en: A large black buzzing bee had built its nest in the tree hollow.

definition: a kind of potherb (details?).
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ತೋಟದಿಂದ ತುಟ್ಟಿ ಸೊಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಕೊಯ್ದು ತಂದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother plucked and brought tutti potherb from the garden.

definition: the grass Eleusine stricta of Poaceae family.
example_en: Nāyirāgi grass has grown in this field.

definition: the quality of giving or spending grudgingly or only through necessity; stinginess; miserliness.
example: ಜೀನಹಂಕತನದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಒಂದು ಹಣವನ್ನೂ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Out of miserliness, he did not spend even a single coin.

definition: the ringing, clanging or clanking sound made by unbroken earthen or metal vessels, bells, etc. when struck with the knuckles.
example_en: The potter struck the pots so that they rang with a clanging sound.

definition: a very short duration of time (just required for a blink of the eye).
example_en: He vanished from there in the blink of an eye.

definition: the offensive smell of urine.
example_en: There is a stench of urine in the toilet.

definition: (it will) become; (it) happens; (it) is; yes.
example_en: He said that everything would turn out fine.

definition: a mean, unworthy man.
example_en: No one wished to talk with that mean, unworthy man.

definition: reverentially saluted.
example_en: The teacher was reverentially saluted by the disciples.

definition: a list , in a library, of available books, its authors, subjects, publishers, date of publication, title of the books, etc. are arranged alphabetically, subject-wise, etc., and also where they may be found.
example_en: I looked at the bibliography catalogue in the library and searched for the book.

definition: a mountain.
example_en: The travellers went around the mountain.

definition: to mix or blend properly.
example_en: The cook blended the flour properly.

definition: a man who hunts or catches wild animals, birds, etc. for food or for a living; a huntsman.
example_en: The huntsman chased a deer in the forest.

definition: (dial.) (pl.) the beginning and the end.
example_en: Everyone knew the beginning and end of that story.

definition: a cuddling; affection; fondness.
example_en: The mother's affection brought joy to the child.

definition: a strong bodied man.
example_en: That strong-bodied man of the village is stronger than everyone.

definition: the main entrance in a fort.
example_en: The guards were always alert near the fort's main entrance.

definition: to make a cage or cage-like structure.
example_en: The carpenter made a cage out of wood.

definition: to cause to pluck or pull off or out.
example_en: He had the flowers plucked in the garden.

definition: something abhorred; something repugnant.
example_en: That work appears repugnant to him.

definition: any of several swift African perissodactylous mammals (family Equidae) of the genus Equus (same as the horse and ass), having dark stripes on a white or tawny body; zebra.
example_en: The zebra runs across the African grassland.

definition: sadness; grief; sorrow; distress.
example: ಗೆಳೆಯನ ಸಾವಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಮ್ಮಳಿಕೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: On hearing news of his friend's death, sorrow arose in his heart.

definition: the direction opposite to north; south.
example_en: The birds fly south in winter.

definition: the chequered cloth or board on which the game of dice is played.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ನೆತ್ತದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟು ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children placed the pieces on the dice board and played.

definition: the bedroom of a married couple.
example_en: They had decorated the married couple's bedroom with flowers.

definition: an aquatic animal.
example_en: The whale is a large aquatic animal.

definition: a man who has run away.
example_en: That man who had run away was caught by the police.

definition: a touch or caress with the lips, as an act of affection; a kiss.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಉಮ್ಮ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The grandfather gave his granddaughter a kiss on the forehead.

definition: the thistle plant Argemone mexicana of Papaveraceae family; gamboge thistle.
example_en: The gamboge thistle plant is full of thorns.

definition: an asterism, containing large number of stars, in the constellation Aquarius; the Sadalsud.
example: ಶತತಾರೆಯು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರಾರು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನಂತೆ ಮಿನುಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The asterism Sadalsud twinkles in the sky like a cluster of hundreds of stars.

definition: the seeds of lablab (Dolichos lablab) soaked and of which the skin is removed.
example_en: Grandmother boiled the skinned soaked lablab seeds and made a dish.

definition: unutilised, fallow or waste land.
example: ಬೇಚರಾಖ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಕೃಷಿಗೆ ಬಳಸದೆ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಬಿಡಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The waste, unutilised land had been left as it was without cultivation.

definition: to prepare another for a religious ceremony, onerous or responsible task.
example_en: The guru prepared him for the religious ceremony.

definition: a woman who has divorced her husband.
example_en: She separated from her husband and became a divorced woman.

definition: the duty or profession of a nurse.
example_en: She carried out the nursing duty honestly.

definition: to change from a solid to a liquid state; to melt.
example_en: The ice slowly melted in the sun.

definition: an unattractive or ugly person.
example_en: No one liked that unattractive person.

definition: to hold in esteem or honour; to have or show respectful regard for.
example_en: Everyone holds his virtue in high esteem.

definition: an unemployed, jobless man (?).
example: ಆ ಓಜಾಳು ಕೆಲಸ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಾ ಊರೂರು ಅಲೆದನು.
example_en: That unemployed man wandered from town to town looking for work.

definition: a discount - a) a reduction from a usual or list price; b) a deduction from a debt, allowed for paying promptly or in cash.
example_en: The merchant gave a discount for the cash payment.

definition: the act of covering a substance (as a metal surface) with a thin coating of gold, silver, tin, etc.; (gold) plating; gilding.
example_en: The skilled craftsman did the gilding work.

definition: a case for keeping or carrying arrows; a quiver.
example_en: He set out with the quiver tied to his back.

definition: the act or process of increasing the speed of; acceleration.
example_en: The new machine helped in the acceleration of the factory.

definition: a half-done, incomplete deed, action or performance.
example_en: His work is always half-done; he never completes it.

definition: a person who is skilled in the techniques of any of the fine arts, esp. in painting, drawing, etc.; an artist.
example_en: That artist draws beautiful pictures.

definition: the auditory passage; the ear.
example_en: Sound reaches the brain through the auditory passage.

definition: a moving to and fro; oscillation; movement.
example_en: The oscillation of the tree branch was caused by the wind.

definition: the language of the people of England; English.
example_en: He speaks the English language well.

definition: that which never changes or varies.
example: ಆ ಸತ್ಯ ಒಂದು ಗಳಿತವಿಕಾರ; ಅದು ಎಂದೂ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That truth is unchanging; it never varies.

definition: a clan of Tamil-speaking people.
example_en: That Mudaliyar family was renowned in trade.

definition: the period or state of confinement and the medical care given during and just after childbirth; puerperium.
example_en: She needs good care during her confinement after childbirth.

definition: to heat (a metal) to make (it) have right temperment.
example_en: The blacksmith heated and tempered the sword's steel.

definition: except; excluding; other than.
example: ರಾಮ ಸಿವಾಯಿ ಬೇರೆ ಯಾರೂ ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲಾಗದು.
example_en: No one except Rama can do this work.

definition: a large drum used to be played with a heavy stick, to proclaim one's victory.
example_en: They beat the victory drum as a sign of triumph.

definition: the quality or state of being unified; unity; singleness.
example_en: The team's unity became the reason for the victory.

definition: one who does not have a male offspring.
example_en: The man who had no male offspring had no support in his old age.

definition: a going out.
example_en: The river's outflow was towards the town.

definition: that causes wonder; wonderful; amazing; marvellous.
example_en: That exhibition was amazing and wonderful.

definition: a mark left by the shod or unshod foot, as in earth or sand; a footprint.
example_en: His footprint was clearly visible in the sand.

definition: difficulty or distress; vexation, affliction; trouble.
example_en: He was worn out by the vexation of court proceedings.

definition: untimely rain; off-season rain.
example_en: The farmers suffered a great loss due to the untimely rain.

definition: widely opened eye; a vigilant watch.
example_en: One must keep a vigilant watch on thieves.

definition: finely ground meal of grain as wheat, rice, etc.; flour.
example_en: They ground the corn in the mill and prepared flour.

definition: a man having courage, resoluteness; a firm-minded or brave man.
example_en: That resolute, courageous soldier was an inspiration to everyone.

definition: (rhet.) a figure of speech, in which the real quality or intensity of the thing in question is denied but the same is ascribed by exaggerating in hyperbolic terms.
example: ಕವಿ ಸುಗುಣಾಪೋಹದಿಂದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ ಅತಿಶಯೋಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet denied the beauty through the figure of speech and described it with hyperbole.

definition: said; told; narrated.
example_en: The story told by the teacher pleased everyone.

definition: a small trumpet-like wind instrument.
example_en: They were blowing the small trumpet at the wedding procession.

definition: to be associated with; to join with; to mingle with.
example_en: The two of them joined together with their friends.

definition: a person who guards (another or another's property etc.).
example: ಕಾಹಕನು ರಾತ್ರಿಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಬಳಿ ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The guard was keeping watch near the field all night.

definition: any vehicle used for carrying a burden or conveying people.
example_en: They used the elephant as a vehicle to carry the load.

definition: an unskilled native labourer; a coolie.
example_en: That unskilled coolie carried stones the whole day.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: The father woke up his son in the morning.

definition: a profoundly tender, passionate affection for another person; love.
example: ಅವಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಿಯ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His love for her grew day by day.

definition: a compelling influence; a constraining force; forceful persuasion; compulsion.
example_en: He agreed under the compulsion of his teacher.

definition: any of various shorebirds of Scolopacidae family with a long, slender, flexible bill used in probing for food, living chiefly in marshy places; a snipe.
example: ಜವುಗು ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಂಡ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಆಹಾರ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The snipe bird was searching for food in the marshy area.

definition: to greatly rejoice; to be delighted.
example_en: At her friend's arrival, she greatly rejoiced.

definition: the sugar-cane juice.
example_en: Everyone likes to drink sugarcane juice in summer.

definition: the spreading annual vine Arachis hypogea of Papilionaceae family with yellow flowers and brittle pods ripening underground and containing one to three edible seeds.
example: ಬಳ್ಳಾರಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲಕಡಲೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: In the Bellary region, they grow the groundnut crop extensively.

definition: the force or sway of the vortex or eddy of water.
example_en: The force of the river's eddy pulled the boat in strongly.

definition: a preserving with great care.
example_en: He preserved the old letters with great care.

definition: the quality of being swift; quickness; swiftness.
example_en: Everyone was amazed by the runner's swiftness.

definition: a demon, the foe of gods.
example_en: The suradvisha was the enemy of the gods.

definition: a set of hanging drapery for concealing all or part of the stage or set from the view of the audience; a curtain.
example_en: They had put up a curtain around the bed.

definition: a funeral feast.
example: ಅಜ್ಜನ ನಿಧನದ ನಂತರ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೊಜ್ಜ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: After grandfather's death, a funeral feast was held at the house.

definition: the act or fact of joining, associating with or together; a being associated.
example: ಎರಡು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The joining of the two organizations started a new project.

definition: the beam of a weighing balance on both sides of which are hung two pans or weighing plates.
example: ವರ್ತಕ ಅಡ್ಡದಂಡಿಗೆಯ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಗೆ ತೂಕ ಇಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The merchant placed weights on both sides of the balance beam.

definition: name of a state, now officially and popularly known as Mahārāṣṭra, in Western India, having Mumbai as its capital.
example_en: The Maratha army was very powerful.

definition: a woman having beautiful posteriors.
example_en: The beautiful-hipped woman's saree looked elegant at her waist.

definition: the outer covering of the arecanut flowers.
example_en: The children used the dried arecanut covering for play.

definition: the water lily plant Nelumbo nucifera ( = Nelumbium speciosum) of Nymphaeaceae family.
example_en: Lotus flowers had bloomed and stood in the pond.

definition: a physical or moral defect; a stain; a flaw; a blemish.
example_en: There was a blemish on that cloth.

definition: a granting of what another desired.
example_en: The king granted the poor man's desired wish.

definition: a great flow of water; flood.
example_en: Because of heavy rain, the flood spread everywhere.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example: ಆ ಕಾವ್ಯದ ಒಂದು ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊರ್ಕುೞ್ ಎಂದು ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: In one line of that poem, they have written 'porkuł' meaning navel.

definition: the quality of lying.
example: ಅವನ ಅಟಮಟಿಗತನ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗಿ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: His habit of lying became known to everyone and trust was lost.

definition: to take the shape of a mould; to be moulded.
example: ಒದ್ದೆ ಮಣ್ಣು ಅಚ್ಚುವಿಡಿದು ಗೊಂಬೆಯ ಆಕಾರ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The wet clay took the shape of the mould and became a doll.

definition: the tree Manilkara hexandra ( = Mimusops kauki) of Sapotaceae family.
example: ಊರ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ಪಾದರಿ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A padri tree had grown near the village.

definition: a kind of medicinal plant; ( = Sorghum nitidum ?).
example_en: The doctor used the leaves of the vēṇupatri plant for the fever.

definition: a blunt knife.
example_en: The fruit could not be cut with this blunt knife.

definition: a soldier who fights boldly and with determination.
example_en: The determined soldier fought bravely against the enemies.

definition: to grow big or large.
example_en: The little calf is growing big quickly.

definition: a handsome hero.
example_en: That handsome hero defeated the enemies in battle.

definition: a harvested field.
example_en: The farmer sat on the bund of the harvested field and rested.

definition: a strong trunk (of an elephant).
example: ಆನೆ ತನ್ನ ತೋರಹತ್ತದಿಂದ ಮರದ ದಿಮ್ಮಿಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿತು.
example_en: The elephant lifted the log with its strong trunk.

definition: the act of settling things properly; arrangement.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಅಣಮಣ್ಣೆ ಮುಗಿಯಲು ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Two days were needed to finish arranging the house properly.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಆ ಸಂಗೀತಗಾರರ ನಡುವೆ ಸೊಗಸಾದ ಪೊದ್ದಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful harmony among those musicians.

definition: fixed; unmoving; settled.
example: ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಬೆಲೆ ಈಗ ನಿರಖು ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The price of that agreement is now fixed.

definition: the plant Phoebe wightii of Lauraceae family.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೂರಮಾವು ಮರಗಳು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿವೆ.
example_en: Kuramavu trees grow abundantly in that forest.

definition: foul or putrid matter; esp. loathsome dirt or refuse.
example_en: The smell of the putrid matter in the drain was very bad.

definition: to be evaporated or dried up.
example_en: The water on the cloth quickly evaporated.

definition: the act or an instance of falling down; a collapsing.
example_en: A collapse occurred to the house wall due to the rain.

definition: to press down with the foot; to set the foot on; to tread; to trample.
example_en: The farmer trampled the dry leaves under his foot.

definition: to attack with a military force.
example: ಪುರಾತನ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಧಾೞಿಡಿದನೆಂದು ಬರೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: It is written in the ancient poem that the king attacked the enemies with his army.

definition: a face showing resentment, dissatisfaction, etc.; a grumpy, sulky face.
example_en: Without saying anything, he sat with a sulky face.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: The beauty of early youth was visible on her face.

definition: a small water-tank or pond.
example_en: There was a small pond outside the village.

definition: the rind or bark of certain trees as arecanut, plantain, etc.
example_en: He peeled off the bark of the arecanut tree.

definition: to poke or jab with a stick, finger etc.
example_en: He poked the dog with a stick.

definition: a professional wrestler.
example_en: The wrestler goes to the wrestling ring every day for training.

definition: the plant Berberis nepalensis of Berberiadaceae family.
example_en: The plant Berberis nepalensis grows on the hill.

definition: any article of food; an eatable.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷ ಬಕ್ಕಣ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: On the festival day, they made a special dish at home.

definition: to exhibit one' adroitness, dexterity.
example: ಸುಬ್ಬನು ತನ್ನ ಕಯ್ಗಾರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಲಘುದೋರಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Subba displayed his skill and amazed everyone.

definition: a supplementary law or an inferred regulation; a by-law.
example_en: The organization brought a new by-law into force.

definition: any man or boy lacking normal function of the testes; a eunuch.
example_en: The eunuch worked as a servant in the palace.

definition: a shallow place in a stream, river, etc., where one can cross; a ford.
example: ಆ ಕಡಗಿನ ಬಳಿ ನೀರು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Near that ford, the water was shallow.

definition: the quality or state of being true; truth.
example_en: Everyone accepted the truth of his words.

definition: the tree Alstonia scholaris of Apocynaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the Alstonia scholaris tree were thick and green.

definition: a condition of difficulty or distress.
example_en: The distress of life wore him down.

definition: the nail - a) the thin, horny sheath growing out at the ends of the fingers and toes of people, monkeys, etc. b) a similar growth on the toes of a bird or some other animals; claw;
example_en: The child's nail had grown very long.

definition: the only sentiment, flavour in a literary piece or in dancing.
example_en: In this poem, the sentiment of love alone fills it throughout.

definition: a place affording protection, as from the elements or danger; a shelter.
example_en: A shelter was built for the poor.

definition: a variety of horse that is of superior breed.
example: ಆ ಬಂಟ ಕುದುರೆ ಓಟದ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: That superior-breed horse won the race.

definition: a machine for excavating; an excavator.
example_en: The excavator is digging the soil.

definition: a wide, hollow, wide-mouthed metal vessel or earthenware.
example_en: She filled water in the wide vessel.

definition: a casual look; a glance.
example_en: She understood the truth in just one glance.

definition: a planning and acting together secretly, esp. for an unlawful or harmful purpose, such as murder or treason; a conspiracy.
example_en: Those who took part in the conspiracy were punished.

definition: an eligible man; one who has legal or moral qualification to be chosen.
example_en: He alone is the eligible man for this post.

definition: the space, amount or degree to which a thing extends; extent.
example_en: The extent of the fire spread across the whole forest.

definition: a region that is not mountainous, but is almost level; the plains; open counry.
example_en: The people of the plains are skilled in farming.

definition: the act of putting back a damaged thing in to good condition.
example_en: The repair of the broken chair must be done today itself.

definition: to join both the palms (to salute, greet, implore, etc.).
example_en: She joined her palms and prayed before God.

definition: a giving or taking of one thing for another; an exchange.
example_en: They made an agreement about the exchange of land.

definition: a flat area of low vegetation dominated by grasses; a meadow.
example_en: Green grass had grown in that meadow.

definition: the quality or state of being red; ruddiness.
example: ಅವಳ ಮುಖದ ಆರಕ್ತತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The ruddiness of her face drew everyone's attention.

definition: a pandal with a swing to play on.
example_en: On the festival day, children played in the swing pandal.

definition: a little house of the crudest kind with a thatched roof; a hut.
example_en: There was a thatched hut at the edge of the forest.

definition: the humming sound of a bee.
example_en: The bee was humming near the flower.

definition: weakness of the heart.
example_en: As he grew old, he developed weakness of the heart.

definition: a young son.
example_en: A young son was recently born to that couple.

definition: a kind of soup made using salt, but without pepper, sour-tamarind pods, etc.
example_en: The doctor advised the patient to drink the plain salted soup.

definition: a presentation; a gift.
example_en: The disciple offered a gift to the guru.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example_en: The women together sang the folk song dummisale.

definition: the fatherhood - a) the state of being a father; paternity; b) the qualities or character of a father.
example: ಅವನ ಅಯ್ತನ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಪಾಲನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His fatherhood was evident in the way he raised his children.

definition: (the heat) to be lost.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಸಿಲಿನ ಕಾಯ್ಪಾಱು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: After the rain came, the heat of the sunshine was lost.

definition: the quality or behaviour of a tough, lawless person; ruffianism.
example_en: His ruffianism caused a disturbance in the school.

definition: to instruct; to command; to order.
example_en: The king commanded the soldiers to move forward.

definition: wholehearted devotion; sincere loyalty.
example: ಆ ಸೇವಕನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಒಡೆಯನ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಣಭಾವ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That servant had wholehearted devotion towards his master.

definition: an optical instrument consisting of two or more lenses or mirrors, used to see distant objects, as stars, which appear larger and nearer; a telescope.
example_en: The scientists studied the planets using the telescope.

definition: a thing for sleeping or resting on; a piece of furniture consisting usu. of a bedstead, bedspring, mattress, and bedding; a bed.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಸೆಜ್ಜೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Grandmother sat on the bed and told a story.

definition: the male of the chicken; a rooster; a cock.
example_en: In the morning the rooster crowed and woke everyone up.

definition: beautiful handwriting, esp. as an art; calligraphy.
example_en: The invitation letter written in beautiful handwriting was lovely.

definition: a kind of medicial herb.
example: ಜ್ವರಕ್ಕೆ ಮಳಲದರಸಿ ಎಂಬ ಮದ್ದಿನ ಗಿಡ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The medicinal herb called malaladarasi is used for fever.

definition: to become heavy.
example_en: The bag, wet from the rain, became very heavy.

definition: an unclaimed estate of a man who died heirless.
example_en: The government took over his unclaimed estate.

definition: the place, as village, town, country, etc. of one's birth.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯೇ ಅವನ ಪುಟ್ಟಜ, ಅಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಅವನು ಬೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That village itself is his birthplace, and he grew up there.

definition: to mix, mingle oneself with.
example_en: He has the nature of mixing with everyone.

definition: a joining together of two or more things, persons in a right and comfortable manner.
example: ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಬೆಸುಗೆ ಏರ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: A good bond was formed between the two families.

definition: associated or connected with.
example_en: This problem is associated with that event.

definition: to cut or chop into very small pieces; to mince.
example_en: Mother minced the onion into tiny pieces.

definition: a man who drinks alcoholic liquor as a matter of habit or to excess; a habitual drunkard.
example_en: The drunkard had fallen down and was lying on the road.

definition: the line at which the earth and sky appear to meet; the horizon.
example_en: In the evening, the horizon was glowing red.

definition: a boy.
example: ಆ ಮಾಣಿ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಡೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That boy walks to school every day.

definition: to put harness on (an ox); to tie a yoke with a harness.
example_en: The farmer put the yoke and harness on the oxen.

definition: a sound.
example_en: The bird's sound was heard early in the morning.

definition: to be broken into small pieces and scattered; to smashed.
example_en: The glass vessel fell down and was smashed into pieces.

definition: a place where the moon-stone is available in abundance (or is excavated); a moon-stone quarry.
example: ಆ ಗುಡ್ಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿರ್ಗಲ್ಲಱೆ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ಹಿರಿಯರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The elders say there is a moon-stone quarry on that hill.

definition: a man with strong shoulders.
example: ಅಂಸಲ ತನ್ನ ಬಲವಾದ ಭುಜಗಳಿಂದ ಹಗ್ಗವನ್ನು ಎಳೆದನು.
example_en: The strong-shouldered man pulled the rope with his powerful shoulders.

definition: to put off to a later time or slow down doing something; to delay.
example_en: He keeps delaying the work still further.

definition: (something) to be realised, understood thoroughly; (enlightenment) to happen.
example_en: Through the teacher's words, understanding dawned upon the disciple.

definition: a protectivemade of metal and used in combat; an armour.
example: ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ವೀರ ಮೆಯ್ಜೋಡು ತೊಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Before setting out for battle, the warrior put on the metal armour.

definition: ostentatious show or display; pomp; pretentiousness.
example_en: Seeing his ostentatious display, people began to laugh.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The blow of his hand struck the chest.

definition: a joining together; an association.
example_en: The association of all the societies became one federation.

definition: the wife of one's husbaṇḍs brother.
example: ಓರಗಿತ್ತಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಕುಳಿತುಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: My husband's brother's wife came to our house and sat for a while.

definition: inevitably; unavoidably; having no alternative.
example_en: Because of the flood, people inevitably left their village.

definition: a great quantity or store of money, valuable possessions, property or other riches; wealth; opulence.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಅಪಾರ ದವಲತ್ತು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That merchant had immense wealth.

definition: the quality of being stupid; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone knows about his stupidity.

definition: the right side (of a person or thing).
example_en: There was a ring on his right hand.

definition: a coin of smallest denomination or value (now archaic).
example_en: There were old dambadi coins in grandmother's box.

definition: a kind of bird.
example_en: A kolaluvakki bird was sitting on the bank of the lake.

definition: to have a halo (as the sun, moon or other luminous, heavenly bodies).
example_en: The moon had a halo at night.

definition: causing, that tends or likely to cause serious harm, danger; disastrous.
example_en: That turn on the road is very dangerous.

definition: the quality or state of being curved, crooked or irregular in shape or form.
example_en: The branch of the tree has grown crooked.

definition: the establishment of one's views, by logical arguement.
example_en: He established his own view through logical argument.

definition: curdled milk; curds.
example_en: She brought curds and added them to the curry.

definition: a ridge or swell moving along the surface of a liquid or body of water; a wave.
example_en: The wave of the sea crashed onto the shore.

definition: unreasonably obstinate; obstinately unmoving; stubborn.
example_en: He is a person of stubborn nature.

definition: unclean matter that soils; dirt.
example_en: She wiped off the dirt on the cloth.

definition: excessive extensiveness or reach of a definition.
example: ಈ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಇರುವುದನ್ನು ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Scholars noticed that there was excessive extensiveness in this definition.

definition: relief from fatigue, exhaustion, weariness.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ವಿಶ್ರಮ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He needed relief from fatigue after the long journey.

definition: a pillar erected as a monument of victory.
example_en: An ancient victory pillar still stands at the border.

definition: overpowering wonder or suprprise; astonishment; amazement.
example: ಆ ಅದ್ಭುತ ದೃಶ್ಯ ನೋಡಿ ನನಗೆ ಬಕ್ಕುಡಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that wonderful sight, I was filled with astonishment.

definition: to be sharp, keen or pointed.
example_en: This knife is sharp and keen.

definition: to cause to slide or slip away.
example_en: The rain water caused the rock to slide away.

definition: an indeclinable representing the sound of hoarse laughing.
example_en: He laughed hoarsely, going 'kahakaha'.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example_en: This house is old, but it is still sturdy.

definition: (dial.) the state in which a thing is.
example_en: Seeing the state in which the house was, he felt relieved.

definition: the condition of being fettered.
example_en: Seeing the prisoner's state of being fettered, the people felt pity.

definition: a person mediating between a seller and a buyer for a fee or a percentage of the sale proceeds or he who negotiates as an intermediary a contract between two or more parties for a commission; a commission agent; a broker.
example: ಆ ದಳ್ಳಾಳಿ ಎರಡೂ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಕಮಿಷನ್ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: That broker took commission from both sides.

definition: a heavy, metal, war-club; a mace.
example_en: Bhima defeated the enemies with a mace.

definition: the plant Centratherum anthelmenticum of Asteraceae family; wild cumin.
example_en: They dried and stored wild cumin for medicine.

definition: a tall spar or, now often, a hollow metal structure, sometimes in sections, rising vertically from the keel or deck of a vessel and used to support the sails, yards, radar and radio equipment, etc. ; the mast of a vessel.
example_en: The ship's mast bent in the storm.

definition: a kind of herb.
example_en: The physician used the edunarige-beru herb for medicine.

definition: to move quickly or whizzingly.
example_en: The arrow whizzed through the air.

definition: a false statement; a lie.
example_en: No one believed his lie.

definition: the shape or form of anything.
example_en: The shape of that doll is very beautiful.

definition: the act of getting or procuring firewood.
example_en: The villagers went to the forest every day to procure firewood.

definition: cooked rice.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಬಾಳೆ ಎಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಸಿ ಓದನ ಬಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother served hot cooked rice on a banana leaf.

definition: the quality or fact of being unsteady, wavering; unsteadiness.
example_en: Everyone came to know the unsteadiness of his mind.

definition: a thread used as a girdle.
example_en: He tied a girdle thread around his waist.

definition: to be invigorated; to be vitalised; to get strength.
example_en: After a good meal, he felt invigorated.

definition: the quality or condition of being easy.
example_en: The ease of the work increased because of the new device.

definition: the glowing gaseous part of a fire; flame.
example_en: A flame rose and leapt up from the hearth.

definition: a dried up water-tank.
example: ಬರಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಊರಿನ ಹೊಟ್ಟುಗೆಱೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಒಣಗಿ ಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: In the drought, the village's dried-up tank completely dried further.

definition: to load a burden on; to place a lond on.
example_en: The worker loaded the bag on his shoulder.

definition: a variety of wheat.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಳಿ ಗೋಧಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: This time they have grown that variety of wheat in the field.

definition: to read aloud a book, pasage, etc.
example_en: He used to read the scripture aloud every night.

definition: a small cube marked on each face with 1-6 spots, used in gaming; dice.
example_en: The children played by rolling the dice.

definition: the buntings, decorative festoon of leaves hung on the small tower on the fort-wall or building.
example_en: They have hung the decorative festoon on the tower on the fort.

definition: a looking subtly.
example_en: She looked at him subtly.

definition: to strive in competition or rivalry with another; to contend for superiority; to view.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಜಗಳಗಂಟಿಯರು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಪಂತಕಟ್ಟಿ ವಾದ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The two quarrelsome men always contend with each other and argue.

definition: a little boy or girl.
example_en: A little child ran about laughing in the courtyard.

definition: a place for urinating; a urinal.
example_en: There was a urinal at the railway station.

definition: the act of shaking (oneself) to and fro or back and forth in quick succession.
example: ಭಯದಿಂದ ಅವನ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಅಲುಕ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A shaking movement appeared in his body out of fear.

definition: a man who robs or commits illegal violence at sea; a pirate.
example_en: That pirate used to loot ships.

definition: the tree Bombax heptaphyllum of Bombacaceae family; silk-cotton tree.
example_en: White cotton is obtained from the silk-cotton tree.

definition: power required for performance; capacity.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಅಟಾಪ ಇದೆ.
example_en: He has enough capacity to finish this work.

definition: an apparatus used to powder or grind; a pulveriser or grinder.
example_en: Mother ground chilli powder in the grinder.

definition: the chief of a regiment or army.
example_en: The commander led his army into battle.

definition: inflammation of the lungs.
example_en: In winter, inflammation of the lungs is commonly seen in children.

definition: to cause to kill, destroy or extinguish.
example_en: He sent an army to destroy the enemies.

definition: a broad, relatively thin piece of stone slab, either dressed or not, fitted on to the ground.
example_en: A stone slab was laid on the ground near the well.

definition: a platform on the bastion that gives a wider range for a firing artilleries.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರು ಮೊಹರ್ಚಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತು ಫಿರಂಗಿ ಹಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The soldiers stood on the bastion platform and fired the cannon.

definition: extra-ordinary strength.
example_en: The man who lifted that hill had extraordinary strength.

definition: a small chisel.
example: ಬಡಗಿ ಕೈಯುಳಿಯಿಂದ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುರುತು ಕೊರೆದನು.
example_en: The carpenter carved a mark on the wood with the small chisel.

definition: a pigment or colouring matter that is mixed with water for use as a paint; water-colour.
example_en: The child drew a picture with water-colour.

definition: to kill (a person).
example_en: That wicked man killed the child.

definition: the space, amount or degree to which a thing extends; extent.
example: ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ಬ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಇಡೀ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬಿದೆ.
example_en: The extent of this problem has spread to the whole district.

definition: without cost of payment; free.
example_en: They distributed the books for free at the school.

definition: the condition of being together as a pair.
example_en: Everyone liked the togetherness of the two of them as a pair.

definition: a killing; slaughter.
example_en: The king gave the order for the slaughter of the enemies.

definition: the final beatitude; the Emancipation.
example_en: Ascetics perform penance to attain the final emancipation.

definition: the tree Artocarpus integra of Moraceae family; jack fruit tree.
example: ಹಿತ್ತಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿಲ ಮರದ ತುಂಬ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The jackfruit tree in the backyard was full of fruit.

definition: to enter into a pact with another king or nation; to covenant; to make a treaty of peace.
example_en: The two kingdoms made a treaty of peace.

definition: a rough paper made of rags.
example_en: They manufactured rough rag-paper from cloth in the factory.

definition: changed; altered; modified.
example_en: The rules of the new scheme are much altered.

definition: (water) to drain out.
example_en: After the rain stopped, the water drained out from the field.

definition: excellent people.
example_en: Excellent people were present at the assembly.

definition: the state or quality of being black; blackness.
example: ಆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಅಸಿತತೆ ಚಿತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಆಳವನ್ನು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The blackness of that colour gave depth to the painting.

definition: upright; erectly.
example_en: He sat upright in the chair.

definition: the rank of a brāhmaṇa; the condition of being a brāhmaṇa.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He was proud of his rank as a brāhmaṇa.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A ballala tree had grown near the village.
